A '''base''' was located on an [[Unidentified airless moon (Olly)|airless moon]]. It featured at least eight sealed [[hangar]] bays spread among several buildings and<ref name="Point" /> during or after [[18 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{TBBDate|311}}</ref> it was used by [[Phee Genoa]] as a base of operations for her [[starship]], ''[[Providence]]''. The station was manned by [[service droid]] [[Olly]] who [[fuel|refueled]] the ships for a price. [[Clone X trooper]] [[CX-2]] landed to the station with his [[CX Dagger vessel]] tracking down Genoa after [[interrogation|interrogating]] [[Ciddarin Scaleback]] for her whereabouts and [[slicer|sliced]] into her ship to retrieve the coordinates for [[Pabu]].<ref name="Point" />
